paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon “niere” grille delivers a motorsport-inspired front-end upgrade engineered with the same precision and material quality that defines Alpha-N's carbon program.

Designed to replace the factory kidney grille assembly, the Alpha-N grille significantly opens up the front fascia and visually aligns the outer grille design with the larger centre intake of the G87 M2 bumper. The result is a more aggressive motorsport appearance inspired by the CSL and GT3-style grilles seen on BMW's latest high-performance models.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Two carbon inserts mounted in OE-style plastic frame
OEM mounting points for direct installation
ft: Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille for BMW M2 G87
